props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating shared digital collaboration environments that preserve trust, accountability, and appropriate boundaries between participants.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Collaboration platforms, shared workspaces, messaging backplanes, and collaborative content services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing baseline trust assumptions for shared collaboration systems before applying modality-specific controls.

metadata.remarks: Collaboration Core defines the foundational trust properties required for shared digital collaboration environments. This pattern establishes identity awareness, boundary control, accountability, and lifecycle awareness without addressing specific collaboration modalities such as chat, meetings, or file sharing.

components.title: Collaboration Identity Context Awareness
components.description: Ensures participant identities and roles are consistently visible and interpretable within collaboration contexts.

props.title: Collaboration Core
props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading through misleading identity presentation in collaboration platforms.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts to misrepresent authority or presence.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding for participant authentication and attribution.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Participants in collaboration systems are authenticated and attributable.
Identity attributes are managed to ensure correct role and context representation.

components.title: Collaboration Boundary and Membership Control
components.description: Constrains who may join, observe, or participate in a collaboration space.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted relationships through unauthorized or external collaboration access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Privileged and role-based access control to collaboration membership.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to collaboration spaces is explicitly managed and reviewed.

components.title: Collaboration Accountability and Observability
components.description: Provides visibility and traceability into collaboration activity for governance and investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence related to collaboration misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and activity tracing to support accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Collaboration events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports oversight and investigation of collaboration activity.

components.title: Collaboration Lifecycle Awareness
components.description: Manages creation, evolution, and retirement of collaboration spaces and artifacts.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence through abandoned or unmanaged collaboration spaces.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle management to reduce residual risk from stale collaboration assets.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Unnecessary or unmanaged collaboration functionality is reduced.
Policies define lifecycle expectations for collaboration spaces.
